title: New US Food Guidelines: Eat Less Meat, More Beans
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: From VOA Learning English, this is the Health & Lifestyle report.
sentences.zh: 从VOA学习英语, 这是健康和生活方式报告。

sentences.en: For a healthy diet, people should eat more beans, peas and lentils.
sentences.zh: 为了健康饮食,人们应该多吃豆子、豆子和扁豆。

sentences.en: They should eat less red meat and processed meats, as well as starchy vegetables, like potatoes.
sentences.zh: 他们应该少吃红肉和加工肉类,以及像马铃薯一样的星状蔬菜。

sentences.en: Also, they should continue to limit added sugars, sodium and saturated fat, an especially unhealthy kind of fat.
sentences.zh: 此外,它们应继续限制添加的糖、钠和饱和脂肪,这是一种特别不健康的脂肪。

sentences.en: That is the latest advice released on December 10 by a panel of nutrition experts.
sentences.zh: 这是营养专家小组在12月10日发布的最新建议。

sentences.en: This panel of experts is responsible for advising the U.S. government about the 2025 dietary guidelines.
sentences.zh: 该专家小组负责就2025年饮食准则向美国政府提供咨询。

sentences.en: These guidelines will inform and shape federal food programs and policy.
sentences.zh: 这些准则将为联邦食品方案和政策提供信息和制定。

sentences.en: But the 20-member panel did not advise on ultra-processed foods that some research findings link to health problems.
sentences.zh: 但由20名成员组成的小组没有就某些研究结果与健康问题有关的超加工食品提出建议。

sentences.en: The panel says there is not enough evidence to tell people to avoid them.
sentences.zh: 陪审团说没有足够的证据告诉人们要避免他们。

sentences.en: And the group did not speak to possibly updating controversial guidance on drinking alcohol.
sentences.zh: 该团体没有谈到可能更新关于酗酒的争议性指导。

sentences.en: They are leaving that issue to two independent reports expected to be released soon.
sentences.zh: 他们将把这个问题留给预计不久将发表的两份独立报告。

sentences.en: Overall, the recommendations for the 2025-2030 Dietary Guidelines for Americans sound familiar, said Marion Nestle.
sentences.zh: 总而言之,关于2025-2030年美国人饮食准则的建议听起来很熟悉,Marion Nestle说。

sentences.en: She is a food policy expert. “This looks like every other set of dietary guidelines since 1980: eat your veggies and reduce consumption of foods high in salt, sugar and saturated fat,” she said in an email.
sentences.zh: 她是一位食品政策专家。 她在一封电子邮件中说 : “ 这似乎是自1980年以来的所有其他饮食准则:吃你的蔬菜,减少食用盐、糖和饱和脂肪中高含量的食物。 ”

sentences.en: She also said the latest advice “says nothing about balancing calories, when overconsumption of calories, especially from ultra-processed foods, is the biggest challenge to the health of Americans.”
sentences.zh: 她还说,最新的建议“没有说要平衡卡路里,因为过度消费卡路里,特别是超加工食品的卡路里,是美国人健康的最大挑战。”

sentences.en: What the scientific panel said about healthy diets The nutrition panel described a healthy diet for people beginning at two years old.
sentences.zh: 营养小组描述人们从两岁开始的健康饮食。

sentences.en: It is high in vegetables, fruits, legumes, nuts, whole grains, fish and vegetable oils that are higher in unsaturated fat.
sentences.zh: 蔬菜、水果、豆类、坚果、整颗谷物、鱼类和植物油含量较高,不饱和脂肪含量较高。

sentences.en: The recommended diet is lower in red and processed meats, sugar-sweetened food and drink, refined grains and saturated fat.
sentences.zh: 推荐的红肉和加工肉类、甜糖食品和饮料、精炼谷物和饱和脂肪的饮食较少。

sentences.en: It may also include fat-free or low-fat dairy and foods lower in sodium and may include plant-based foods.
sentences.zh: 它还可包括无脂或低脂乳制品和钠含量较低的食品,可能包括植物食品。

sentences.en: This panel worked on the guidelines for almost two years.
sentences.zh: 该小组就准则开展了将近两年的工作。

sentences.en: It was the first to consider dietary needs based on financial situation, race, ethnicity and culture.
sentences.zh: 它是第一个根据经济状况、种族、族裔和文化考虑饮食需求的国家。

sentences.en: Panelist Fatima Cody Stanford is an obesity expert and doctor at Massachusetts General Hospital.
sentences.zh: 讨论家Fatima Cody Stanford是麻省综合医院的肥胖症专家兼医生。

sentences.en: In an email, she said that considering these new elements will help make sure that the guidance “... reflects and includes various population groups."
sentences.zh: 她在一封电子邮件中说,考虑这些新内容将有助于确保指导“......反映并包括各种人口群体”。

sentences.en: Missing from the guidelines The panel did not advise on two controversial food groups: ultra-processed foods or alcohol.
sentences.zh: 小组没有就两个有争议的食品群体提出建议:超加工食品或酒精。

sentences.en: Ultra-processed foods make up about 60 percent of the American diet.
sentences.zh: 超加工食品占美国饮食的60%。

sentences.en: The panel considered more than 40 studies.
sentences.zh: 小组审议了40多份研究报告。

sentences.en: Several of them showed links between ultra-processed foods and being overweight or obesity.
sentences.zh: 其中一些显示了超加工食品与超重或肥胖之间的联系。

sentences.en: But the nutrition experts had concerns with the quality of the research.
sentences.zh: 但营养专家对研究的质量很关切。

sentences.en: So, they said the evidence was too limited to make recommendations.
sentences.zh: 因此,他们说,证据太有限,无法提出建议。

sentences.en: The panel also did not change recommendations about alcohol.
sentences.zh: 小组也没有改变关于酒精的建议。

sentences.en: The current guidelines are two drinks or less a day for men and one drink or less a day for women.
sentences.zh: 目前的指导方针是男子每天喝两杯或不到两杯,妇女每天喝一杯或不到一天。

sentences.en: The last time the guidance was updated was in 2020.
sentences.zh: 上一次更新该指南是在2020年。

sentences.en: At that time, the government rejected the advice of scientific advisers to recommend less alcohol consumption.
sentences.zh: 当时,政府拒绝了科学顾问关于建议减少酒精消费的建议。

sentences.en: Two separate government groups expect to release reports in the coming months on the effects of moderate alcohol use to inform the guidelines.
sentences.zh: 两个不同的政府团体预计将在未来几个月内发布关于中度饮酒影响的报告,以通报准则。

sentences.en: Do Americans follow dietary guidelines? The advisory panel said they know that the diets of most Americans do not meet the current guidelines.
sentences.zh: 美国人是否遵循饮食准则? 顾问小组说,他们知道大多数美国人的饮食不符合目前的准则。

sentences.en: More than half of all adults in the country have one or more diet-related chronic health condition.
sentences.zh: 全国一半以上的成年人患有一种或多种与饮食有关的慢性病。

sentences.en: And 18 million individuals and families have insecure sources of food, the report says.
sentences.zh: 报告说,1 800万个人和家庭的食物来源不安全。

sentences.en: The report adds that “…nutrition-related chronic health conditions” will continue “to threaten health through the lifespan.” It adds that this is not good “for the future of health in the United States.”
sentences.zh: 该报告补充说,“......与营养有关的慢性健康状况”将继续“危及整个生命期的健康”。 该报告补充说,这对“美国未来的健康”并不好。

sentences.en: What happens next? The scientific report informs the dietary guidelines which are updated every five years.
sentences.zh: 接下来会发生什么?科学报告为每五年更新一次的饮食准则提供了信息。

sentences.en: These new recommendations now go to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这些新建议现在提交美国。

sentences.en: Health & Human Services (or HHS) and the U.S.
sentences.zh: 卫生与公众服务(或HHS)和美国

sentences.en: Department of Agriculture (or USDA). Officials there will create the final guidance and release it next year.
sentences.zh: 农业部(或农业部),那里的官员将制定最终指南,并于明年发布。

sentences.en: As of December 11, the public has 60 days to comment on the guidance.
sentences.zh: 截至12月11日,公众有60天时间对指南发表意见。

sentences.en: HHS and USDA officials will hold a public meeting on January 16 to discuss the recommendations.
sentences.zh: HHS和USDA的官员将于1月16日举行公开会议,讨论这些建议。

sentences.en: And that’s the Health & Lifestyle report.
sentences.zh: 这是《健康与生活方式报告》。

sentences.en: I’m Anna Matteo. JoNel Aleccia reported this story for the Associated Press.
sentences.zh: JoNel Aleccia向美联社报导此事。

sentences.en: Anna Matteo adapted it for VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: Anna Matteo改编成VOA英文学习版。
